MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

2. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 81

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 121

4. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 1
   C. 9
   D. 20

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

6. Solve for x: x + 3 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 15
   D. 12

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 20
   C. 75
   D. 40

8. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 48
   D. 49

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 5

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

13. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

14. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 72

15. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

16. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/2

17. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 13

18. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 14

19. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 57
   C. 1
   D. 15

20. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

21. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

22. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 22
   C. 55
   D. 32

24. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
